CalendarSubscriptionCreateRequest.description: Subscribe to a remote ICS or webcal URL. webcal:// is normalized to https://; only http/https are accepted.

url.description: Remote ICS or webcal URL. webcal:// is accepted and normalized to https:// before fetch.

groupSlug.description: Group slug when creating the collection on a team principal (same as Calendar/set). Omit or null for a personal calendar. Group members then see the subscribed collection.

CalendarSubscription.description: Live remote ICS/webcal subscription. Fetch URL and status live here, not on JMAP Calendar.isSubscribed.

id.description: Subscription id (also exposed as Calendar.subscriptionId on Calendar/get).

calendarId.description: Read-only calendar collection created for this subscription (personal or team principal).

CalendarFeedPublishRequest.description: Optional publish mode. Omitted mode leaves an existing feed unchanged and creates a new feed as full.

mode.description: full strips people, alarms, and private details. busy publishes every event as a Busy placeholder.

CalendarFeed.description: Owner-visible published ICS/webcal feed URLs for an owned personal calendar.

webcalUrl.description: Same feed advertised as webcal:// for calendar clients.

mode.description: full strips people, alarms, and private details. busy publishes every event as a Busy placeholder.
